Resources

The Control Device Function Code Resource

A control device function code resource contains the code to implement a control panel and respond to messages from the Finder. A control device function code resource is a resource of type 'cdev' and must have a resource ID of -4064. This resource must begin with a control device function (see "Control Device Functions" beginning on page 8-75 for more information).
